description: Run your 3D printer from workflows through OctoPrint: check how a print is going, upload G-code and start printing, pause, resume or cancel, preheat and cool down, send G-code and take a webcam picture. Start a workflow when a print finishes, fails or pauses, or the printer disconnects.

octoprint_print_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a print stops before the end: cancelled, or failed because the printer reported an error, or only one of the two. Each run says which, and the printer's error.

parameters.description: Only prints of files in this folder in OctoPrint, such as prints. Leave blank for every file.
parameters.name: folder

parameters.description: failed for only failed prints, or cancelled for only cancelled ones. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: outcome

octoprint_print_finished_trigger.description: Runs when a print finishes, with the file, how long it took and the filament it used, even a short print that started and ended between two looks. Prints from the printer's SD card aren't seen.

parameters.description: Only prints of files in this folder in OctoPrint, such as prints. Leave blank for every file.
parameters.name: folder

octoprint_print_paused_trigger.description: Runs when a print is paused, from OctoPrint, by the printer (such as for a filament change) or by another app, with how far along it is. A pause shorter than the workspace's polling interval may be missed.

octoprint_printer_disconnected_trigger.description: Runs when the printer disconnects from OctoPrint (turned off, unplugged or disconnected) or reports an error, or only on errors, with the printer's state and error.

parameters.description: error for only errors, not a printer turned off or disconnected. Leave blank for both.
parameters.name: which
